text: 10月16日，证监会发布行政处罚决定书显示，3名自然人因操纵市场及内幕交易被罚。其中，周吉锋、周吉辉操纵证券市场共计被罚没约3.28亿元，陈秋航因内幕交易被罚没近1.82亿元。
text_en: On October 16, the CSRC issued an administrative penalty decision showing that three individuals were penalized for market manipulation and insider trading. Among them, Zhou Jifeng and Zhou Jihui were collectively fined and had illegal gains confiscated totaling about RMB 328 million for manipulating the securities market, and Chen Qiuhang was fined and had illegal gains confiscated totaling nearly RMB 182 million for insider trading.
